name: bigquery-analytic-hints
description: Recommends and routes to BigQuery AI capabilities for next-step data analysis. Use during exploratory data analysis, time-series or cohort pattern investigation, or text corpus exploration in BigQuery when the user has not requested a specific AI function. Proactively suggests relevant built-in BigQuery AI functions (forecasting, anomaly detection, tabular prediction, change point analysis, key driver attribution, trend/seasonality decomposition, or semantic text classification) as concise follow-up actions. Do not use for writing or looking up exact SQL syntax and function arguments, dataset or table administration, DDL/DML migrations, query performance troubleshooting, or permission checks.
